Check: Source files present
Rule: all expected files resolve in dataset/source/

Check: Crime file schema
Rule: required columns present; spacing or case drift is handled

Check: Offence categories mapped
Rule: no unmapped PROMIS category; ANZSOC assault category present

Check: Region crosswalk covers all rows
Value: 0 new police region(s), 0 new SA2 name(s)
Rule: every police region and NT Balance SA2 maps to an NTG region
Note: 377 NT Balance rows have SA2 'Unknown' and go to Top End [A5]

Check: Calendar completeness
Rule: only documented gaps; gaps stay NaN, never imputed
Note: Nov 2023 is the documented PROMIS-SerPro gap [A3]

Check: Raw file rebuilds the processed panel
Rule: rebuilt region-month counts equal the panel

Check: Provisional window flagged
Rule: months within 6 months of the As At date are not scored as FAIL

Check: Crime release freshness
Value: As At 01 Jun 2026, 139 days before the check date
Rule: WARN if older than 62 days (monthly release)
Note: check data.nt.gov.au for a newer release

Check: Alcohol supply lag
Value: latest supply quarter 2025-Q4, 2 quarter(s) behind the latest crime month
Rule: WARN if more than 2 quarters behind; Model B only
Note: supply is context only; the forecasts do not use it

Check: Population estimates cover the crime months
Rule: WARN if crime months run past the latest population year
Note: 2026 rates use 2025 population [A22]; the panel waits for new estimates [A1]
